# confluencedc_group (Resource)

Manages a Confluence group. Group creation and deletion delegate to Confluence's configured user directory (internal, LDAP, Crowd, etc.); if the active directory is read-only, create/delete operations will fail with the error Confluence's API returns, which is an environment concern rather than a provider limitation. Existing groups (for example those synced from an external directory) can be brought under management with `terraform import`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "confluencedc_group" "developers" {
  name = "developers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the group. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The group name. Identical to `name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import confluencedc_group.example <group_name>
```
